turns.question: Which companies filed 8-Ks under Item 5.02 about executive or director changes in January and February 2026? Summarize three of them, and cite the filings.

report.markdown:
Based on the SEC 8-K filings in the selected source, multiple companies filed Item 5.02 reports (Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers) in January and February 2026. Here are three summarized examples:

---

### 1. **The Walt Disney Company (DIS)** — Filed February 3, 2026
**Event date:** February 2, 2026
**Action:** CEO succession plan announced. The Board appointed **Josh D’Amaro** (Chairman of Disney Experiences) as Chief Executive Officer effective March 18, 2026, and named current CEO **Robert A. Iger** as Senior Advisor through December 31, 2026. The Board also intends to elect D’Amaro as a director following the 2026 annual meeting.
[1]

---

### 2. **DoorDash, Inc. (DASH)** — Filed January 20, 2026
**Event date:** January 16, 2026
**Action:** The Board increased its size to eleven members and elected **Milan Kovac** as a Class III director. Kovac, age 41, most recently served as VP of Optimus Robotics at Tesla and also serves on the board of Boston Dynamics. He was appointed to the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee.
[2]

---

### 3. **Amphenol Corporation (APH)** — Filed February 5, 2026
**Event date:** February 4, 2026
**Action:** **Martin H. Loeffler** (Chairman since 1997, CEO 1996–2008, President 1987–2006) notified the company of his intent to retire from the Board at the 2026 Annual Meeting (expected May 2026). The Board appointed **R. Adam Norwitt**, current President and CEO, as Chairman of the Board effective at the same meeting. David P. Falck continues as Lead Independent Director.
[3]

---

**Other notable filings in the window** (not summarized above) include Charles Schwab (SCHW) appointing a new CTO/Operations Officer, AMD adding a director, QUALCOMM reporting a director resignation, Applied Digital Corp with a management update, and AST SpaceMobile noting a director departure. The source catalog covers 8-Ks from January 2, 2025 through March 12, 2026 for the 100 most liquid stocks plus all Item 1.05 filings, so this list reflects the coverage in the selected document source.

On February 4, 2026, after more than five decades with Amphenol Corporation (the “Company”), including serving as President from 1987 to 2006, Chief Executive Officer from 1996 to 2008 and as Chairman of the Board since 1997, Martin H. Loeffler notified the Company that he intends to retire from the Board of Directors of the Company (the “Board”), effective on the date of the Company’s 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, which is expected to be in May 2026 (the “Meeting Date”). Mr. Loeffler’s retirement from the Board is not the result of a disagreement with the Company on any matter relating to the Company’s operations, policies or practices. Item 7.01.
